action.rationale: White is in check from the c3-bishop after ...Bxc3. Only b2xc3, Qd2, and Bd2 are legal. Board facts: the c3-bishop is dark-squared, so b2xc3 captures it with a pawn; White is down material (lost a knight for nothing on c6) and must limit damage while completing development. No castling is currently legal. Start with full broad coverage at depth 4 before selecting a candidate.
